_comment: Boston's 2026 trade-deadline position-player pickups — the single source
of truth for both the Python pipeline and the app. build_dataset.py copies
this file to app/src/roster.json; the app renders one page per entry.
Prose templates live in app/src/copy.js — the fields here are facts.
slug        URL key (?player=<slug>) and data filename
mlbam       MLBAM id; null = resolve by name at fetch time (a pinned id
is cross-checked against the lookup and fails loudly on a
mismatch, so a typo can never silently fetch another hitter)
bats        R / L / S — picks the same-handed Fenway comparison pool
kd, kl      trajectory drag/lift constants; omit to refit on the
player's own tracked 2026 home runs (needs >= 10 of them)
Erik Miller (LHP) and Carlos Gutierrez (MiLB OF) are deliberately absent:
no MLB batted balls to translate.
